Package org.rapidcow.trivnote.libexpr

Class Atom

java.lang.Object
org.rapidcow.trivnote.libexpr.Atom
All Implemented Interfaces:
Datum
Direct Known Subclasses:
Scalar, Symbol
public abstract sealed class Atom extends Object implements Datum permits Scalar, Symbol
A non-cons non-nil Datum. Concretely, it covers two types of atoms:
  • The Scalar, which holds an arbitrary value.
  • The Symbol, which holds a unique, interned value from a (hopefully) fixed pool of vocabulary.

Presently, an atom’s value is a freeform Unicode string, represented by value().
